thread:
maria: Hey team — need help routing an expedited approval for a POC with a FinTech customer. They're asking for a 6-week commit + 40% off hosted rate for first 3 months. Need to know which CPQ fields to set and expected SLA. cc @jim @devon
jim: Can you paste the CPQ Opportunity ID and the exact pricing terms? We need to check against commit thresholds.
maria: OPPTY-4521. Terms: 6-week trial, then 3 months at 40% off list for hosted API usage up to $150k. After that standard tier. Also asking for dedicated capacity option in contract.
alex: Quick note — for POC we'll provision a small dedicated pool; ops needs the expected peak RPS and model list.
maria: Peak ~50 rps, models: redwood-ggml-70B-q4 (quantized) and a reranker. Limit to ~1k tokens concurrent per request.
jim: For dealdesk please set CPQ fields: `deal_type=POC`, `special_pricing=TRUE`, `commit_length=6_weeks`, `commit_value=150000`, `pricing_matrix=POC-40`. Attach security signoff if requesting dedicated.
devon: If dedicated included, we need a SOW addendum + infra security review. ETA legal review 3 business days if docs are complete.
sam: Dedicated is fine but we need VPC + firewall details and customer SOC contacts. Ops default onboarding SLA is 24h response; can expedite to 8h with Priority Onboarding (+fee).
maria: What routing queue should pick this up? Need approval within 48h to keep momentum.
jim: Route to `dealdesk/pricing-exceptions` queue, approval path: sales_manager -> dealdesk_pricing -> legal (if dedicated) -> VP_sales if commit_value > 100k. Dealdesk review SLA: 36h.
maria: Can you add a pre-approval template? We have to fill SF fields: `cf_commit_length`, `cf_commit_value`, `cf_pricing_reason`, `cf_approval_required`, `cf_escalation_path`.
jim: I'll create an Approval Request in SF using the "POC Fastlane" template and tag `expedite:true`. If `special_pricing=TRUE` it auto-notifies pricing team; `dedicated_requested=TRUE` will ping legal+ops.
maria: Anything else needed from SE before I submit?
alex: Please attach the POC runbook + success criteria and a minimal prompt set for quality checks. Also include run-rate estimates (tokens/user/day) and peak RPS.
jim: Once submitted expect an automated ack from dealdesk, then manual review. Set ticket SLA fields: `approval_sla_hours=36`, `escalation_sla_hours=12`. If no response, auto-escalate to VP_sales after 48h.
maria: I'll attach docs and submit now. Thanks :pray:
dealbot: Approval request created OPPTY-4521-AR-884 — status: pending -> routing: pricing-exceptions.
maria: ping @jim if stuck, will follow up tomorrow.
